summary: I re-ran the full unit suite (87/87 pass) and probed the verifier and read the DB, provider and prompt code against the foundation criteria. Migrations are checksummed, transactional and tested. The audit log is append-only. package.json has zero dependencies. Provider output is schema-validated, bounded by timeouts, and the notes reach the model only as escaped data. Two gaps are carried to later phases: the live claude -p isolation check was not re-verified, and the verifier has no measured corpus. Both are disclosed in the submission and neither blocks this phase.

criteria.description: Notes parser and deterministic grounding verifier (D4)
Validated structured output, injection-safe prompt, timeouts, malformed output (D4, D5)

findings.title: Live claude -p isolation not re-verified
findings.detail: The reconcile re-run of the isolation check failed with exit 127 because its scratch script was missing. Only the earlier init check passed, and there is no test/live test yet. The tool allowlist (ALLOWED_TOOLS) and the pinned argv are unit-tested against a fake only.
findings.recommendation: Resolved when a test/live test asserts the init event lists exactly ALLOWED_TOOLS with empty mcp_servers, skills and slash_commands, and passes in the live-eval or verification phase.

findings.title: Verifier quality unmeasured
findings.detail: My probes behaved correctly: an altered time, an altered number, an unsupported cause and invalid or missing cites were all flagged. No labelled corpus exists, so M1 grounding validity is not yet measured.
findings.recommendation: Resolved when the eval phase reports M1 against the thresholds fixed in the brief.

findings.title: Unused async loader
findings.detail: loadSqlite in src/db/connection.js is exported but redundant with loadSqliteSync.
